user.title: Smart Home Index
user.description: Smart Home Index compares your devices with its catalog of smart home devices. The catalog downloads from smarthomeindex.com now and once a day after that, so the first setup needs an internet connection. Matching runs on this machine; your device list never leaves Home Assistant. Links open smarthomeindex.com.
